title: ticfac Phase 3: role jobs, retire Markdown as lifecycle implementation
description: SPEC §12 Phase 3. review-epic and closeout-epic run as role jobs with validated results and evidence records on both executors. Delete (not extract) the lifecycle loop from extensions/ticks-runner/runner.ts, merge.ts, boundary.ts and agent-runner.md. Keep authoring policy (good-tick, super-tick, DoR, roadmap, role, EPIC-SKELETON) and a concise tracker-facing runner contract in ticks; move role prompts, executor procedures and operator guidance to ticfac. Conformance tests prove every executor obeys the same lifecycle and boundary.
acceptance_criteria: Gate: an epic's review and closeout run as role jobs with evidence records and no person reading runner Markdown; the ticks skill no longer contains a lifecycle; both executors pass the conformance suite.
